import re

UKEYS = ['length', 'format', 'version', 'unit_type', 'abbr_offset', 'addr_size']

def clean(v):
    v = v.strip()
    if v.startswith('(') and v.endswith(')'):
        v = v[1:-1].strip()
    m = re.match(r'^"(.*)"$', v)
    if m:
        v = m.group(1)
    return v

def parse(lines):
    files, flines = [], []
    units, ulines = [], []
    dies, dlines = [], []
    attrs, alines = [], []
    skip = []
    cur = None
    curtag = None
    last = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(\S.*?):\s+file format (\S+)\s*$', l)
        if m:
            files.append({'file': m.group(1), 'format': m.group(2)})
            flines.append(i)
            last = None
            continue
        if re.match(r'^\.debug_\w+ contents:', l):
            skip.append(i)
            last = None
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+): (\w[\w ]*?Unit): (.*)$', l)
        if m:
            rest = m.group(3)
            kv = dict(re.findall(r'(\w+) = ([^,\s]+)', rest))
            row = {'offset': m.group(1), 'unit': m.group(2)}
            for k in UKEYS:
                row[k] = kv.get(k, '')
            n = re.search(r'next unit at (0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)', rest)
            row['next_unit'] = n.group(1) if n else ''
            units.append(row)
            ulines.append(i)
            last = None
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+):( +)(\S.*?)\s*$', l)
        if m:
            last = None
            if m.group(3) == 'NULL':
                skip.append(i)
                continue
            cur = m.group(1)
            curtag = m.group(3)
            dies.append({'offset': cur, 'depth': max(0, (len(m.group(2)) - 1) // 2), 'tag': curtag})
            dlines.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\s+(DW_AT_\w+)\s+(.*?)\s*$', l)
        if m and cur is not None:
            last = {'die_offset': cur, 'tag': curtag, 'attribute': m.group(1), 'value': clean(m.group(2))}
            attrs.append(last)
            alines.append(i)
            continue
        if last is not None and l[:1] in (' ', '\t'):
            last['value'] = (last['value'] + ' ' + l.strip()).strip()
            alines.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = []
    if files:
        blocks.append({'name': 'files', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': flines, 'records': files})
    if units:
        blocks.append({'name': 'units', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': ulines, 'records': units})
    if dies:
        blocks.append({'name': 'dies', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': dlines, 'records': dies})
    if attrs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'attributes', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': alines, 'records': attrs})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
